suite: Suite PR #558 (Capital Portfolio Studio and AFE Cost Control Manager Full precision switch and AFE As of input, stacked on #554)

beginner.append: Read the figures in the Capital Portfolio Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
beginner.why: The cards print whole $MM against a tolerance of 0.001.

id_emv_at_first_limit_musd.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 4 decimals (jest: capitalportfoliostudio/__tests__/w3FullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull, checked against the key first).

intermediate.append: Read the figures in the AFE Cost Control Manager with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping. Type the as-of date above into its As of box first.
intermediate.why: The tiles print CPI and SPI to 2 decimals, and SPI was always measured at today; the prompt asks 5. The new As of input (default today) measures SPI at the stated date.
